name: How do I choose a reliable general contractor for my bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reliable general contractor for my bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a general contractor, look for one with a strong track record of successful bathroom remodels, especially in your local area. Check for proper licensing, insurance, and positive client references or reviews. Request detailed proposals from multiple contractors that outline the scope of work, timeline, and costs. Ensure clear communication and a contract that specifies all terms, warranties, and payment schedules. A good contractor provides transparency and manages the project effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a general contractor with a strong local track record, proper licensing, insurance, and positive reviews. Get detailed proposals and clear contracts.
